title: Behavioral test feedback for one-step repair of LLM-generated code: data and analysis
description: Corpus, paired outcomes, analysis code, input validation and isolated replay for the paper "Behavioral test feedback for one-step repair of LLM-generated code" (O. Kholodniak, O. Prokhorov). The evidence archives with prompts, responses, programs and evaluation logs are a separate record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23129973.
